title: Puzzle 3D Resumable Vertical Slice
description: Phase 4 of the Interactive Job Runtime Refactor. Convert Puzzle 3D fill and collision into bounded resumable InteractiveJob state machines with deterministic sequencing, persistent cursors, live coalesced preview overlays, cancellation, replay and worker-count determinism. Hard ceiling is 8 ms per step; normal fill/collision steps target 1–2 ms. No private threads or solver-specific scheduler. Preserve schema-first owned job/progress contracts and validate through bun+nx native/release/wasm gates. This is a clean breaking greenfield refactor; no legacy adapter.
